mapper.select: SELECT id, tabla, tipo, busqueda, 'polygon' AS geomtype, ST_AsText(the_geom) AS wkt, ST_Y(p) || ',' || ST_X(p) AS coord_merc, ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(p, 900913), 4326)) || ',' || ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(p, 900913), 4326)) AS locacion FROM (SELECT *, ST_PointOnSurface(the_geom) AS p FROM m) q ORDER BY prio, length(busqueda), busqueda LIMIT #{rows}
SELECT tipo, count(*) AS total FROM m GROUP BY tipo, prio ORDER BY prio
